rules: Define one primary audience and job before broadening segments.
Distinguish evidence, assumption, and strategic choice.
Position against the real alternative, including doing nothing.
acceptance_checks: The promise is specific enough to be disproven.
No invented market fact is presented as research.

rules: Sequence launch work by dependency and learning value.
Tie each message to a segment and each channel to an objective.
Define measurement and stop/scale thresholds before launch.
acceptance_checks: The plan can be executed without guessing ownership.
